prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in League City, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1288; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident and my injury, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. For the record, we're speaking about a collision in a parking lot in League City, Texas. Can you describe what happened?
A: I was backing out of a parking space near the store entrance. I checked my mirrors and had just started rolling when another vehicle came down the aisle and clipped my rear quarter panel.
Q: Were you moving slowly?
A: Yes, very slowly. Maybe walking pace. I didn't see the other car until it was already there.
Q: Did the other driver stop?
A: They did. We got out and looked at both cars. Their bumper was scraped, and my rear panel had a dent and a cracked taillight.
Q: Did anyone call for police or file a report?
A: The store manager came out and took our information. I don't think an officer came.
Q: When did you first notice an injury?
A: My right knee. When I stepped down from the car, it buckled a little. By that evening it was swollen and stiff.
Q: Did you seek medical care?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the next day. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.
Q: Had you injured that knee before?
A: Not that I can recall. I play some recreational softball, but nothing serious.
Q: Is there anything else you want to add?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble with stairs and I've missed a few days of work. That's about it.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
